title: GTA 6 Release Time India: Midnight Local, NZ Goes First
description: GTA 6 release time India: PC Gamer says Rockstar's rolling launch unlocks at midnight local time on November 19, with New Zealand playing first.

body.text: The GTA 6 release time India players should plan around follows a rolling launch, according to PC Gamer. Rockstar support says the game unlocks at midnight on November 19 in your own local time zone on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. That means it is not a single global moment, and New Zealand gets to play first.
GTA 6 release time India: what we can and can't say

PC Gamer's guide does not give a specific time for India, so there is no confirmed IST figure to quote here. The logic of a rolling launch is that each time zone unlocks when its own clock hits midnight on November 19, going by Rockstar's support page.

There is a catch. PC Gamer notes that unlock screens on PlayStation show all US players can start at midnight Eastern, which is 9 pm Pacific. The same may be true on Xbox, and other regions may be grouped in a similar way, despite what Rockstar's support page says. So treat your exact start time as something to confirm on your console's unlock screen.

Because midnight arrives earliest in New Zealand, players there, and everyone in that same time zone, will be first to boot up the game. PC Gamer's piece frames everyone else's wait as how many hours behind New Zealand they sit.
The writer jokes that Florida should get an upgrade from Eastern to New Zealand time for this one launch. It is a joke, and nothing in the source suggests it will happen.
On past big console launches, some players changed their console's region setting to spoof a different time zone. That let them start playing before midnight where they actually live.

Will it work for GTA 6? PC Gamer says it isn't sure, only that people will definitely try. Some earlier launches put measures in place to block it. The publication points readers to Sony's guidance on changing a PlayStation account region and Microsoft's explainer on updating an Xbox account country, but says you shouldn't do it unless you are really moving to New Zealand.

items: Rockstar support: midnight local time on November 19
Platforms covered: PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
First to play: New Zealand and its time zone
US players: midnight Eastern, per PlayStation unlock screens

body.text: Keep an eye on the unlock screen on your PS5 or Xbox, since that is where PC Gamer got its confirmed US timing and where any grouping for other regions would show up. Also watch whether Rockstar or the platform holders block region spoofing, because the source says that outcome is unknown. Messing with your account region carries its own risk, so wait for the official clock rather than gamble with your account.

faqs.q: What is the GTA 6 release time in India?
faqs.a: According to PC Gamer, Rockstar support says GTA 6 unlocks at midnight local time on November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The article does not list an India-specific time, and it notes some regions may be grouped differently.

faqs.q: Who gets to play GTA 6 first?
faqs.a: PC Gamer reports that players in New Zealand, and anyone in the same time zone, will be first to play because the launch rolls out at local midnight rather than at one global moment.

faqs.q: Will changing my console region to New Zealand unlock GTA 6 early?
faqs.a: PC Gamer says it is not sure the trick will work, though people will definitely try it, and some past launches have blocked it. The publication also advises against changing your account region unless you are actually moving.
